title: Ground Truth Availability Effect: Does Having Access to Verifiable Ground Truth Change Weak-to-Strong Dynamics?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Direct and compelling: if weak-to-strong generalization fails without ground truth, this is a fundamental limitation for safety-critical applications where ground truth is unavailable. Addresses a core open question.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running parallel weak-to-strong fine-tuning experiments on different task types. Setting up the fine-tuning pipeline, selecting appropriate verifiable and non-verifiable benchmarks, and controlling confounders is substantial for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two parallel experiments (verifiable and non-verifiable), each requiring its own dataset, fine-tuning run, and evaluation. The comparison doubles the scope. Hard to complete in 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
